owner_direction.exact_choice: Use the same final-action sequence everywhere, with Roshan visibly finishing each task (recommended).
owner_direction.scope: All Roshan-owned job tasks and substeps across actual job days and Opera training/freeplay
owner_direction.qualification: Direction accepted; existing artwork, motion, runtime, device and comprehensive report acceptance are not implied.

intent: The child directs the work. Roshan herself visibly performs the last meaningful action on the same object, releases or settles safely, and leaves a readable result before celebration or the next task.

sequence.requirement: A valid touch gives prompt visible response and preserves the child’s selected answer/plan.
Roshan reaches the actual target through current navigation. No remote progress.
The child’s existing gesture drives the relevant operation; hand/tool makes local visible contact.
Roshan visibly finishes the exact task verb. Do not replace work with a cheer or auto-solve a choice.
Same hands, cuffs, prop, support, costume and room persist; release into a clear stable state.
The actual earned object/state stays visible and consistent with the saved consequence.
Celebrate only after the real finish is legible; retain existing specialist/voice/return ownership.

presentation.direction: Shared stage-size work presentation; migrate the legacy small activity-card format
presentation.qualifier: This is the scoped layout plan. Runtime layout is not yet changed.
presentation.camera: Keep the room and actor scale/identity continuous within each job. Any closer work framing uses the same transition grammar in training and story, not a nested unrelated mini-scene.
presentation.composition: Full 1280x720 base Canvas stage with supported expanded aspects; give hands and target enough screen area for phone readability. Keep Back/voice cues reachable and result visible.
presentation.actor_ownership: Only one live Roshan presentation at a time. Transfer between route actor and work presentation coherently; no duplicate tail, disappearance or costume substitution.
presentation.reuse: Use approved source families and the same career-specific props/costume/room. Candy gold-paper study is a pilot family, not a different art medium for every job.

resolution.multi_screen_rule: Native coverage is measured per playable screen; preserve panorama composition and use non-overlapping 1024 cards after source acceptance.
resolution.runtime_texture_rule: At most 1024 longest side or power of two; POT only for VRAM compression. Preserve original masters.
resolution.character_prop_rule: Choose native pose/prop density for actual largest draw size; no unreviewed enlargement to conceal missing detail. Individual cutout sources need not meet a background dimension requirement.
resolution.review_key_gap: Current 1672x941 full scene keys do not satisfy native 2048x2048 background coverage.
resolution.required_receipt: Original dimensions, exact source hash, master provenance, output/tile hashes and measured display scale; padded/upscaled tile dimensions are insufficient.

specialist_constraints: Ballerina held poses/one-shot curtain call remain under DL-MOT-09; common format does not create a looping work animation.
Teacher: child chooses/counts/combines; Roshan visibly confirms or places the chosen result without solving for the child.
Geode: Roshan opens a supported geode with crystals remaining embedded inside both halves; no loot drop.
Nursery: preserve Faron’s role, baby conservation, continuous support and safe resting states.
ChapterTwo cake: keep Farmer→Chef→Candy Maker dependencies and correct fruit counts/tiers; park the rocket unlaunched where specified.
Boxer/Racer and other specialists retain their current input and action owners; stage-wide presentation alone is not final-contact acceptance.
Existing Day One owner-selected story clips retain their separate scoped authority; no new movie inserted to replace the child’s action.

lifecycle.progress: Validate current intentional request, actual target/contact and required work; a timer, final pose or clip end alone cannot award progress.
lifecycle.interrupt_before_commit: Cancel unfinished work on retarget, exit, pause/focus policy and teardown; clear touch/callback ownership.
lifecycle.interrupt_after_commit: Keep earned progress, place the prop safely and suppress duplicate rewards on restore.
lifecycle.save: Add compatible defaults only; never remove save keys or infer completion from animation timestamps.

hard_gaps: Wrong final verb or missing final action
Unreadable hand/target scale or cropped anatomy
Missing ordinary runtime route or device/child/owner evidence
quality.acceptance: Score each relevant item/lane separately. Source 4.5 does not transfer to motion or runtime; priorities at exactly 4.5 remain included.

implementation.qualification: No measured runtime timing/sockets are fabricated. Coverage rows are planning entries, not accepted action bindings.
